description: The three active definitions exactly match the public-data importer. Extensions are design proposals and are not seeded or extracted by the demo.

definitions.description: Structural session boundary, not semantic event detection
Order of sessions within the source conversation

extensions_not_loaded.policy: Use a versioned domain vocabulary; inferred assignments are soft retrieval clues until validated. Do not encode sensitive identity in free-form topic labels.
Activity is a source-grounded content annotation, not proof that an event occurred. Occurrence and modality require explicit fields.
Keep raw time text, anchor and timezone separately. Never use import time as the unknown event time.

invariants: A content label is not an authorization grant.
Missing annotations mean unknown or unprocessed, not false.
Extraction confidence is neither truth probability nor retrieval relevance.
The same text copied through several agents is one source lineage, not independent corroboration.
Changing the meaning of a vocabulary key requires a new key or version.
